summary: Arkanoid entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Arkanoid
entries.definitive_edition: Official Arcade Archives/Arcade Archives 2 arcade rerelease

emulation.emulator: MAME for original arcade comparison only
emulation.notes: Prefer official Arcade Archives for main archive play; use MAME/original hardware only to compare timing and spinner feel.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original arcade hardware with spinner controls

primary.why: The current Hamster Arcade Archives route is an official preservation-style release designed around faithfully reproducing classic arcade games, making it the cleanest legal modern route. Original arcade hardware/MAME remains the comparison ceiling for spinner feel and PCB behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official Arcade Archives release where available, with original display options and no rewind/assist features for the main capture. Record platform, display settings, input device, and whether a spinner/original arcade comparison was done.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original Taito cabinet behavior and spinner-controller feel
secondary.what_to_play: Run a short comparison if input authenticity matters.
secondary.why: A paddle/spinner game can feel meaningfully different with digital controls.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether assists, rewind, scanlines, or non-spinner controls were used.
